about: Craft checklist, department packaging (P3b, docs/CRAFT_CURRICULUM.md). Same shape as training/video_criteria.json, plus artefact (the field the check reads), source (docs/research/CRAFT_SOURCES_2026-10.md section and verdict, the repository rule, or 'Blueprint 2026-10 (unverified)') and enforced_by (an existing path, a planned validator with its phase in planned, or manual). check = code (a validator measures it), critic (the script-critic or editorial review ticks it), eye (the creator's or Claude's look at the frames), manual (a person does it). Every number is a BP id in sourced_rules.json; nothing here is binding: no row has two verified source types yet. Skill: .claude/skills/shorts-for-video/SKILL.md.
